summary: Tested all 3 tasks from NEXT_TASKS_2026-10-24 for CloudIVR web (preview, DRY-RUN) at 1920px and 390px. Backend: new pytest suite (19/19 pass) covers coupon/today, calendar status/connect 503/slots 400/callback 302 expired, enabling booking blocked with 400 calendar_not_connected (agent unchanged), custom booking settings saved, invalid timeZone -> America/New_York and slotMinutes 7 -> 30, record toggle saved, recordRate 0.02/recordingDays 90/record:true, MP3 returns 200 audio/mpeg, transcript first line has 'This call may be recorded', and Bob gets 404 on Alice's call/agent/slots. Sandbox unit suite js/tests/test_ai_booking_recording_2026-10.js: 65/65 pass. Frontend: coupon banner works (code NMD108XZJUA, countdown ticks every second, Use it -> /buy?coupon=... and checkout auto-applies 10%: $50 -> $45; no purchase made). FR/ES work, no overflow at 390. Channel card: Alice and Bob don't see it, the sidebar link goes to https://t.me/CloudIVRNET with target _blank, and a new QA account sees the card (join href/target correct, FR/ES ok). Dismiss hides it and it stays hidden after reload. SIP page: Alice sees both numbers with credentials, sip.speechcue.com, reveal, copy and reset. Bob sees only the locked list with Upgrade (no leak). FR/ES ok, 390 ok. Agent page: Record calls row and hint ok. Toggle starts ON; turning it OFF and saving persists after reload, then turned back ON. Book appointments section, disabled toggle and unavailable note ok in EN/FR/ES. Call history: headphones icon, <audio> plays (readyState 4, 26s), 'kept until Jan 22, 2027' and transcript ok. AI campaign created (preview, not started): kind text has '+$0.02 recorded' and campaign-stat-booked is present. Fixed one UI bug (squished toggle switches).

minor.issue: Code-review bug (cannot be run now: needs a connected calendar). needCalendar blocks ANY save whose body has booking.enabled=true while the calendar is not connected. If an agent had booking ON and the owner disconnects, or Google revokes access / keys are removed, AgentForm still sends f.booking.enabled=true. The booking toggle is then disabled (disabled={!connected}), so the owner cannot turn it off and cannot save any other edit (greeting, record, etc.): every save returns 400 'Connect your Google Calendar before turning on bookings'. Fix: only block when enabled goes from false to true (compare req.agent.booking.enabled), and/or in the frontend send enabled: b.enabled && connected, and/or set booking.enabled=false on all agents in gcal.disconnect/markRevoked.

Call recordings (caller voice/PII) are served without login. The URL only has the chatId plus 11 hex characters (about 44 bits). Consider signed or expiring URLs, or a login-protected proxy for ai-call recordings.

ui_bugs.component: ui.js Toggle (agent form Record calls / Book appointments / Take messages)
ui_bugs.issue: Toggle had no shrink-0, so next to long hint text the switch was squished: 18-20px wide at 390px (knob outside the track) and 41px at desktop. FIXED by testing agent (added shrink-0); now 44px at all widths.

issues: The credential cards are stacked with 0px gap. Each SipCredentials card is rendered inside an inline <span> wrapper, so the parent's space-y-4 margin has no effect on inline elements. The Zoiper/Linphone/MicroSIP guide boxes also touch (0px gap) under space-y-3. Fix: use 'flex flex-col gap-4' / 'flex flex-col gap-3' instead of space-y-*.
The 'AI agent' label sits directly under the Caller ID select with no spacing. The right column has extra empty space above 'Calls at the same time'.
The Telegram channel link (sidebar-channel-link) only exists in the desktop Sidebar. MobileNav has no channel link, so accounts older than 30 days on mobile cannot reach the channel.
The date in 'conservé jusqu'au Jan 22, 2027' is not localized: day() uses the browser locale, not the app language.
SlotPreview uses the native <input type=date> and the booking hours use native <input type=time>, while the project already has a DateTimePicker component used elsewhere (campaign schedule).

action_items: Fix the needCalendar lock-out: an agent with booking.enabled=true and a disconnected/revoked calendar can never be saved, because the toggle is disabled and the PUT returns 400.
SIP page: replace space-y-* with flex flex-col gap-* (cards and guide boxes currently touch, because of the inline span wrapper).
Add the Telegram channel link to MobileNav ('More' menu).
Consider protecting AI call recording URLs (auth or signed/expiring links).

Frontend bundle was built with an old REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL: the audio src and API go to roadmap-preview-11.preview.emergentagent.com while frontend/.env says 4ea97153-... Both route to this pod so it works, but restart the frontend so the bundle uses the current .env.
Optional: dismiss key 'civr.channelCard' in localStorage is shared by every account in the browser; make it per account (e.g. civr.channelCard.<accountId>).
critical_code_review_comments: ai.js needCalendar: a stale booking.enabled=true blocks every save once the calendar link is gone (see backend minor #1).
Banners.js CouponBanner: after the countdown hits 0 the banner hides but does not refetch the next day's coupon until reload (acceptable).
Banners.js ChannelCard: the dismiss flag is global per browser, not per account.
PUT /ai-agents/:id is a full replace (missing name -> 400 'Give the agent a name.'). Fine for the UI, but partial updates via API are not supported.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all requested flows pass; 1 toggle layout bug fixed, minor spacing issues remain)
